preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
Each integer n must be between 1 and 100,000.
Each integer k must be between 0 and n.
The sum of all n values across all test cases must not exceed 2,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if k > n - 1 else True
postconditions.description: If k is greater than n - 1, output -1 indicating no valid permutation exists.
The output must contain exactly n integers representing the permutation.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) in range(1, n + 1) for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: All elements in the output permutation must be integers between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: sum(i == int(x) for i, x in enumerate(stdout.split(), start=1)) == k
postconditions.description: The number of indices i for which A_i = i must be exactly k.
